name: The Tailor
description: A famous tailor begins to sew a wedding dress for his best friend’s fiancée – but all three have dark secrets that will soon upend their lives.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After a painful visit to his hometown, a famous tailor returns to Istanbul with a secret. Meanwhile, his best friend hides a secret of his own.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After Esvet runs away, a devastated Dimitri asks for Peyami’s help. Sülün insists on Firuze marrying Mustafa, but Peyami confronts his grandmother.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Tensions simmer between the two families during a dinner at Peyami’s. Firuze’s negligence could spell disaster for Peyami.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Dimitri is angry with Faruk after Esvet escapes again. Firuze accepts Sülün’s proposal. Peyami discovers Firuze’s true identity.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Dimitri’s doubts put Peyami in a tough spot and lead him to take drastic measures. During a dress fitting, sparks fly between Firuze and Peyami.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sülün confirms her suspicions about Firuze after talking with Lia. Dimitri learns the real reason behind why Ari’s determined to find Esvet.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Esvet discovers Peyami's secret identity. Dimitri pays a visit to Peyami's home. A confrontation at the ranch ends in unexpected tragedy.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Peyami drinks to forget his troubles and brings a date to Dimitri and Esvet's wedding. But when the ceremony starts, Peyami is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After a wild night, Dimitri wakes up alone. Peyami skips an important meeting to be with Cemre. Esvet and Peyami argue — and disaster strikes.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Peyami faces pressure to deliver his new collection and Ari threatens to replace him. Dimitri shares news with his family, to Esvet's dismay.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Dimitri tells Ari what he knows about Esvet's parents. An office cleaner helps Peyami after he has a meltdown. Mustafa sees a face from his past.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Peyami visits Osman and demands answers about his mother. Dimitri makes a surprise announcement at dinner and later, walks in on a shocking scene.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While cleaning, Kumru finds a piece of the past that inspires Peyami to draw on the joyful memories of his grandfather. Esvet pays a visit to Kumru.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A reenergized Peyami drops a bombshell and Dimitri forces him into a showdown. Esvet meets Peyami at a restaurant where his past meets his present.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Dimitri destroys a painful relic from his childhood. Learning the truth about his parents, Peyami moves forward with unveiling his new collection.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Returning home from a long business trip, Peyami locks eyes with Esvet at a welcoming party — and Dimitri makes a stunning announcement.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Facing the inevitable, a tearful Peyami says goodbye to Esvet, while Dimitri gets drunk and humiliates his father.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A clever plan from Peyami's parents buys him time to figure out his next move. Dimitri becomes paranoid, accusing Ari of manipulating him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Esvet and Peyami steal time together and make decisions. But when Dimitri can't reach either one of them by phone, he gets suspicious.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The clock ticks down on the trip to the US while Peyami tries to come clean to an increasingly frantic Dimitri — and Esvet can't bear him anymore.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Ari arrives at the ranch for a tense meeting with his son. Later, Peyami helps cover up Dimitri's lies.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Peyami and Esvet walk in on a disturbing scene when they meet Dimitri. The two men reminisce about their childhood before disaster strikes.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As Peyami tries to make sense of tragedy, a mysterious message sends him back to a place from his youth. Esvet learns the truth about her ancestry.
